basis: The August 23 earnings release was the earliest qualifying disclosure found. Its consolidated statements report net sales of $234,222,000 for fiscal Q4 ended June 29, 2023, versus $257,748,000 for fiscal Q4 ended June 30, 2022. The reported decline was 9.1%, putting sales $10,638,600 below the $244,860,600 threshold. The prior-year quarter contained an extra week, which is included in the reported comparison.

coverage.detail: The November 17, 2022 investor presentation reviewed FY2022 performance and growth strategy. It gave no FY2023 Q4 consolidated sales forecast.
The February 1 Q2 release reported $274.3 million of quarterly net sales, discussed the Just the Cheese acquisition and gave a qualitative second-half outlook. It supplied no Q4 sales range.
On the February 2 Q2 call, management discussed nutrition bars and a long-term goal of growing into a $2 billion business. Neither established a Q4 sales ceiling.

The May 2 Q3 release explicitly addressed Q4. Management expected to ship nutrition bars to additional customers and aimed to accelerate volume growth. It gave no dollar or percentage forecast for Q4 consolidated net sales.

The Q3 Form 10-Q reported $765,464,000 of first-nine-month sales. As a retrospective check, subtracting this from the $999,686,000 fiscal-year actual announced August 23 gives the same $234,222,000 Q4 actual.

On the May 3 Q3 call, management described planned Q4 nutrition-bar and cheese shipments and discussed weaker consumer demand. It gave no numerical ceiling for total Q4 sales. The issuer’s May 2 release identifies the call date.
The separate May 2 exhibit announced a $1.50 special dividend and gave no Q4 sales figure.
The June 12 Form 8-K announced the elimination of the executive vice president of sales and marketing position and Shayn Wallace’s departure.
The issuer’s annual report identifies the June 30 Form 8-K exhibit as Wallace’s separation agreement, effective June 29.
The July 18 release announced annual and special dividends of $0.80 and $1.20 per share, respectively. It gave no preliminary Q4 sales figure.

Across the issuer’s FY2023 and FY2024 archive headings, the only release listed between May 2 and August 23 is the July 18 dividend. Searches for intervening presentations, preliminary results and public management guidance found no earlier qualifying disclosure.

The issuer-hosted August 23 release reports the 9.1% decline and separately estimates a 2.1% decline after adjusting for the extra prior-year week. The consolidated GAAP table gives both quarters’ reported dollar amounts directly.

publication_date_evidence: The issuer-hosted release and SEC Exhibit 99.1 both carry the Elgin, Illinois dateline of August 23, 2023 and state that the company announced the results that day. The issuer’s press room also lists the release under August 23.
